source_manifest.title: Scaling Neural Machine Translation
source_manifest.finding: Ott et al. independently implement Transformer-big in fairseq, match original accuracy, and scale to 128 GPUs and approximately 150M sentence pairs. Hardware and optimization changes preclude attributing every speedup to architecture.

source_manifest.title: How Much Attention Do You Need? A Granular Analysis of Neural Machine Translation Architectures
source_manifest.finding: Domhan reproduces Transformer-base at 27.5 versus reported 27.3 BLEU. Controlled component experiments retain some Transformer advantages, but improved RNN/CNN baselines narrow gaps and decoder replacements often match it.

source_manifest.title: Why Self-Attention? A Targeted Evaluation of Neural Machine Translation Architectures
source_manifest.finding: Tang et al. find stronger translation and word-sense disambiguation results, but no general superiority over RNNs on long-distance subject-verb agreement. Head count and hyperparameters matter.

source_manifest.title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
source_manifest.finding: AllenAI tests the acknowledged quadratic attention bottleneck and replaces full attention with local/global sparse attention. Runtime measurements, ablations and downstream experiments show useful long-document Transformer variants.

source_manifest.title: Molecular Transformer: A Model for Uncertainty-Calibrated Chemical Reaction Prediction
source_manifest.finding: IBM/Cambridge explicitly adapt Vaswani et al. to chemical SMILES reaction prediction: 90.4% top-1 USPTO_MIT accuracy, 88.6% with mixed reactants/reagents. Reports deployment in IBM RXN.

source_manifest.title: A Survey of Transformers
source_manifest.finding: Fudan researchers identify the original architecture as the foundation of Transformer variants, pretrained encoder/decoder models and applications across language, vision and audio; explicitly discuss efficiency and generalization limits.

source_manifest.title: Microsoft Custom Translator pushes the translation quality bar closer to human parity
source_manifest.finding: Microsoft reports completed Custom Translator migration from LSTM to Transformer architecture, also powering Translator API, Office 365, Speech, Bing and Edge. This documents deployment, not an independently audited benefit estimate.

source_manifest.title: An Empirical Study of Mamba-based Language Models
source_manifest.finding: Controlled 8B-model comparisons on shared training data find pure Mamba models weaker at copying/in-context learning; hybrid models retaining attention outperform the Transformer comparator across twelve standard tasks. Independent of Vaswani et al., with Mamba authors participating.

source_manifest.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
source_manifest.finding: Gu and Dao report faster inference and competitive language modeling without attention. This is contrary evidence to universal architectural superiority, not a refutation of successful Transformer construction.

search_gaps: Lifetime landmark assessment through the requested as-of date; selected evidence spans 2018–2024 and is not a census of all 2025–2026 uses. This challenge cohort is not an unbiased training sample.
Original v7 gives 41.8 English-French BLEU in abstract/table but 41.0 in section 6.1; no attempt is made to certify every original numerical claim.

Tang et al. contradict the proposed long-range-dependency superiority explanation. Domhan shows component confounding and competitive hybrids. Binary existence questions do not express the magnitude of these qualifications.

Long-sequence usefulness is established for an explicitly modified descendant, not unrestricted scalability of the unchanged 2017 model. Modern model evidence concerns architectural lineage, not every original hyperparameter.

PMC chemistry page became captcha-blocked; the publicly accessible arXiv manuscript was downloaded and read instead. Mamba 2023 is abstract-level contrary evidence, supplemented by full-section reading of the controlled 2024 comparison.
Original assessment used v7; any future predictive training input should use the first-publication v1 text to avoid later-revision leakage. This challenge record is excluded from such training.

limitations_survived remains unknown: the available explicit long-sequence limitation test demonstrates success of a replacement mechanism, not clearly the original method under the limiting conditions. The rubric does not specify whether repaired descendants count.
research.summary: Independent implementations reproduced the central Transformer translation result. Direct extensions, chemical reaction prediction, production translation and later synthesis document sustained usefulness. Nineteen questions have affirmative evidence; survival of explicitly stated limitations remains unknown because the strongest evidence tests a repaired descendant. Contradictory dependency tests, competitive hybrids and attention-free alternatives qualify claims of universal superiority.
